dedupe_keys.name: eurare rare earth element occurrences and deposits in europe

description: This dataset classifies rare earth element (REE) deposits and occurrences in Europe. It was produced in the EU-funded EURARE project and published in June 2015; BGS lists it on data.gov.uk with links to the EURARE project site and to a BGS OGC web feature service for European minerals data (m4eu). Coverage is Europe; the number of sites, attribute fields and file formats are not stated on the page read. Access: the WFS endpoint is public, while data.gov.uk lists copyright as vested in NERC with reuse needing BGS permission; no price is stated. Caveats: the classification reflects knowledge in 2015, is not planned to be updated, and the entry text is very short. For simulation it locates European REE resources, useful for critical raw material supply scenarios and to test how much European demand for magnets and electronics could be met from domestic deposits. Related catalogue records include the UK mineral processing, refining and recycling facilities dataset and the USGS Mineral Resources Data System.
